title: Family Medicine Physicians
description: Diagnose, treat, and provide preventive care to individuals and families across the lifespan. May refer patients to specialists when needed for further diagnosis or treatment.

tasks.text: Prescribe or administer treatment, therapy, medication, vaccination, and other specialized medical care to treat or prevent illness, disease, or injury.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Prescribing therapy requires licensed clinical accountability

tasks.text: Order, perform, and interpret tests and analyze records, reports, and examination information to diagnose patients' condition.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Image interpretation assists; radiologist owns diagnosis

dwas.name: Analyze test data or images to inform diagnosis or treatment.
Order medical diagnostic or clinical tests.

tasks.text: Collect, record, and maintain patient information, such as medical history, reports, or examination results.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

dwas.name: Collect medical information from patients, family members, or other medical professionals.

tasks.text: Monitor patients' conditions and progress and reevaluate treatments as necessary.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI aids chart review; clinical observation of patient is human

dwas.name: Monitor patient progress or responses to treatments.

tasks.text: Explain procedures and discuss test results or prescribed treatments with patients.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Results delivery needs empathy and clinical judgment

dwas.name: Explain medical procedures or test results to patients or family members.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Advise patients and community members concerning diet, activity, hygiene, and disease prevention.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Wellness advice needs tailoring and clinical accountability

dwas.name: Provide health and wellness advice to patients, program participants, or caregivers.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

dwas.name: Advise communities or institutions regarding health or safety issues.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Direct and coordinate activities of nurses, students, assistants, specialists, therapists, and other medical staff.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient care supervision is live clinical leadership

tasks.text: Refer patients to medical specialists or other practitioners when necessary.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Clinical referral judgment needs licensed human accountability

dwas.name: Refer patients to other healthcare practitioners or health resources.

tasks.text: Coordinate work with nurses, social workers, rehabilitation therapists, pharmacists, psychologists, and other health care providers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Plan, implement, or administer health programs or standards in hospitals, businesses, or communities for prevention or treatment of injury or illness.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Drafts health program design; implementation and buy-in human

dwas.name: Design public or employee health programs.

tasks.text: Train residents, medical students, and other health care professionals.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

tasks.text: Prepare government or organizational reports which include birth, death, and disease statistics, workforce evaluations, or medical status of individuals.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Health records drafted; clinician verifies and signs

dwas.name: Prepare official health documents or records.
